title: Execute audited Rating component polish
description: Complete Rating implementation from the audit after modularization, covering display modes, threshold clarity, accessibility, and final visual QA.
objective: Make Rating a professional filter type instead of a generic option group with an icon.
expected_outputs: Mechanical implementation commit b72af3a adds Rating text, icon, and icon plus text display modes
Threshold guidance added in the Rating Elementor controls
Keyboard/focus behavior preserved with focus-within styling and native radio inputs
Rating controls stay inside DEC-EIT-014 line budgets
Clear-only behavior remains available through active chips and needs Guilherme visual QA

Selected and unselected states are controllable.
Threshold behavior is clear to an implementer and end user.
Guilherme visual QA is required before calling the visual state complete.
